question: Which Anuttara Vidyā yoginī is identified by the transmitted syllables hasraiṃhasrīṃhasrauḥ?
premises: The formula contains the transmitted syllables hasraiṃhasrīṃhasrauḥ.
The colophon names Anuttara Vidyā Yoginī.
It is designated as a root mantra.
inference: This transmitted formula is the root mantra of Anuttara Vidyā Yoginī.
uncertainties: The leading marker 11 is retained as transmitted without interpretation.
plain_english: “Hasraiṃ hasrīṃ hasrauḥ” — thus is the root mantra of Anuttara Vidyā Yoginī.
